title: DNS web control-plane panels mediated by Nostr events

criteria.statement: DNS dashboard exposes human operator controls for zone create/reconcile, policy apply, record override, and drift remediation.
Actions use the Nostr DNS control-plane client/store and do not add REST write or fetch-based mutations.
UI run data includes operator/auth readiness, request event id, relay OK acceptance summary, status progress events, final result, and rejection/errors.
Forms validate locally enough to avoid malformed command payloads while leaving control-plane result events as source of truth.
Completion remains driven by explicit DNS result events with no timeout-as-done behavior.
